Walk-in clinics fill up by 9 AM. Over 6 million Canadians don't have a family doctor. Dr. Maple sits in the middle. Except we have to go back to Western for our Computer Organization & Architecture midterm on Saturday morning. Not exactly ideal timing. But that's kind of just what being a CS student looks like sometimes, you don't always get to pick when things overlap, you just figure it out.
